caption: The drawing features a central heart shape with German text written inside it. Surrounding the heart are four birds, two at the top and two at the bottom, rendered in profile and perched on stylized branches with leaves and flowers. The birds at the top are yellow with red accents on their wings and tails, while the birds at the bottom are red and brown with red, yellow, and white patterns on their wings and tails. The flowers are pink with red accents, and the leaves are green with brown stems. At the top and bottom of the heart, there are circular, star-like floral patterns composed of red, green, and yellow segments. The drawing uses primarily muted tones of red, yellow, green, brown, and pink on a beige background. The border is simple, and the name "Chas. Readman" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Fractur
